claims.allowed_now_ko: CAPE-KG를 한국어 장문 업무 문서의 evidence-grounded procedural KG construction task로 정의했고, CQ/schema/evidence/validator/standard bridge를 결합한 pre-human 방법론 산출물을 구축했다고 말할 수 있다.
claims.allowed_now_en: We can describe CAPE-KG as a pre-human, evidence-grounded procedural KG construction framework combining CQs, schema control, evidence grounding, validation, and standard-taxonomy bridging.
claims.forbidden_now_ko: EACL 제출이 완료되었거나, 최종 성능 우수성이 입증되었다고 말하면 안 된다.
claims.forbidden_now_en: Do not say the EACL submission is complete or that final superiority has been proven.
required_before_stronger_claim: Final paper tables refreshed after human returns
claims.safe_phrasing_ko: 본 연구는 CAPE-KG task framing과 pre-human 실험 인프라를 완성했으며, 최종 성능 claim은 human-gold 이후 확정한다.
claims.safe_phrasing_en: We present the CAPE-KG framing and pre-human experimental infrastructure; final performance claims remain gated by human-gold evaluation.
unsafe_phrasing_examples: CAPE-KG is ready for EACL submission.
CAPE-KG outperforms all baselines on the target corpus.

claims.area: KG construction counts and structural integrity
claims.allowed_now_ko: Layer 1 NCS/PCF와 Layer 2 업무 KG가 구축되었고, 현재 Layer 2는 220 nodes, 947 edges이며 accepted edge evidence 누락과 dangling edge가 없다고 말할 수 있다.
claims.allowed_now_en: We can report constructed KG counts and structural checks: Layer 2 currently has 220 nodes and 947 edges with no missing accepted-edge evidence or dangling edges.
claims.forbidden_now_ko: 이 count를 human-gold 정답 대비 정확도 또는 추출 성능으로 해석하면 안 된다.
claims.forbidden_now_en: Do not interpret construction counts as human-gold accuracy or extraction quality.
claims.safe_phrasing_ko: Layer 2 KG construction is complete as an automatic build artifact: 220 nodes and 947 evidence-linked edges.
claims.safe_phrasing_en: The Layer 2 KG is complete as an automatic build artifact: 220 nodes and 947 evidence-linked edges.
unsafe_phrasing_examples: The constructed KG is correct with high precision.
The KG has been fully validated by humans.

claims.allowed_now_ko: 현재는 main extraction result가 pending human-gold라고만 말할 수 있다.
claims.allowed_now_en: At present, main extraction performance must be described as pending human-gold evaluation.
claims.forbidden_now_ko: silver/proxy F1을 final main table 또는 논문 성능 우수성으로 제시하면 안 된다.
claims.forbidden_now_en: Do not present silver/proxy F1 as the final main-result table or as superiority evidence.
required_before_stronger_claim: P_cape_kg_actual scored against adjudicated human gold
claims.safe_phrasing_ko: Main extraction performance is not yet claimable; the scoring pipeline is ready and waiting for adjudicated human-gold returns.
claims.safe_phrasing_en: Main extraction performance is not yet claimable; the scoring pipeline is ready pending adjudicated human-gold returns.
unsafe_phrasing_examples: CAPE-KG achieves the best extraction F1.
The main table proves the proposed method is superior.
claims.next_gate: human-gold annotation, IAA, adjudication, and scoring

claims.allowed_now_ko: 자동 구축 edge의 evidence attachment와 component span diagnostic은 보고할 수 있지만, human-gold faithfulness claim은 보류해야 한다.
claims.allowed_now_en: We can report automatic evidence attachment and component-span diagnostics, while holding human-gold faithfulness claims.
claims.forbidden_now_ko: evidence span 정확도 또는 unsupported edge 감소를 human-gold로 입증했다고 말하면 안 된다.
claims.forbidden_now_en: Do not say evidence-span correctness or unsupported-edge reduction is proven against human gold.
claims.safe_phrasing_ko: Evidence diagnostics are available, but faithfulness claims remain diagnostic until adjudicated span evidence is imported.
claims.safe_phrasing_en: Evidence diagnostics are available, but faithfulness claims remain diagnostic until adjudicated span evidence is imported.
unsafe_phrasing_examples: CAPE-KG eliminates hallucination.
Evidence spans are human-validated.

claims.allowed_now_ko: B0-B6, P_cape_kg_actual, P_minus_* 조건과 Qwen3 scaling을 실행했고, 현재 수치는 silver/proxy diagnostic이라고 말할 수 있다.
claims.allowed_now_en: We can report that B0-B6, P_cape_kg_actual, P_minus_* ablations, and Qwen3 scaling diagnostics were run.
claims.forbidden_now_ko: P_cape_kg_actual이 baseline보다 최종적으로 우수하다고 말하면 안 된다.
claims.forbidden_now_en: Do not claim final superiority of P_cape_kg_actual over baselines yet.
required_before_stronger_claim: Same frozen metric definitions applied to adjudicated human gold
Final statistical tests after human-gold scoring
claims.safe_phrasing_ko: Baseline, ablation, and scaling runs are complete as silver/proxy diagnostics; final comparative claims require human-gold scoring.
claims.safe_phrasing_en: Baseline, ablation, and scaling runs are complete as silver/proxy diagnostics; final comparative claims require human-gold scoring.
unsafe_phrasing_examples: Qwen3-32B-AWQ proves monotonic model scaling.
The ablation proves CQ improves final F1.

claims.area: Structural conformance, procedural consistency, and CQ answerability
claims.allowed_now_ko: ontology conformance, procedural consistency, CQ answerability 같은 자동 구조 진단은 보고할 수 있다.
claims.allowed_now_en: We can report automatic structural diagnostics such as ontology conformance, procedural consistency, and CQ answerability.
claims.forbidden_now_ko: 구조적으로 answerable하다는 사실을 답변의 human-gold correctness로 해석하면 안 된다.
claims.forbidden_now_en: Do not treat structural answerability as human-gold answer correctness.
required_before_stronger_claim: Human-gold correctness check for extracted items
Human review of structural gap worklist
claims.safe_phrasing_ko: Structural diagnostics indicate schema and query coverage, not final semantic correctness.
claims.safe_phrasing_en: Structural diagnostics indicate schema and query coverage, not final semantic correctness.
unsafe_phrasing_examples: All competency questions are correctly answered.
The KG is semantically complete.

claims.allowed_now_ko: PAGED/Text2KG adapter 기반 public cross-check를 auxiliary diagnostic으로 실행했다고 말할 수 있다.
claims.allowed_now_en: We can report the PAGED/Text2KG adapter runs as auxiliary diagnostics.
claims.forbidden_now_ko: public benchmark 결과를 private Korean enterprise corpus의 main result로 대체하면 안 된다.
claims.forbidden_now_en: Do not replace the private Korean enterprise main result with public-adapter diagnostics.
required_before_stronger_claim: Explicit benchmark scope and adapter limitations
claims.safe_phrasing_ko: Public benchmark runs are auxiliary adapter diagnostics, not official leaderboard or private-corpus main evidence.
claims.safe_phrasing_en: Public benchmark runs are auxiliary adapter diagnostics, not official leaderboard or private-corpus main evidence.
unsafe_phrasing_examples: The public benchmark proves generalization of the private-corpus method.
These are official benchmark leaderboard results.

claims.allowed_now_ko: NCS/PCF Top-K mapping 후보와 Layer2-bridged NCS-PCF crosswalk 후보를 생성했다고 말할 수 있다.
claims.allowed_now_en: We can report that NCS/PCF Top-K mapping candidates and Layer2-bridged NCS-PCF crosswalk candidates were generated.
claims.forbidden_now_ko: expert review 없이 P@K, MRR, nDCG@10, utility, accept-rate를 주장하면 안 된다.
claims.forbidden_now_en: Do not claim P@K, MRR, nDCG@10, utility, or accept-rate without expert review.
claims.safe_phrasing_ko: The standard bridge is candidate-generation evidence only until mapping and crosswalk expert review is complete.
claims.safe_phrasing_en: The standard bridge is candidate-generation evidence only until mapping and crosswalk expert review is complete.
unsafe_phrasing_examples: CAPE-KG improves NCS/PCF mapping accuracy.
The crosswalk utility is expert-validated.

claims.allowed_now_ko: active/uncertainty/random review queue와 human-effort 입력 양식이 준비되었다고 말할 수 있다.
claims.allowed_now_en: We can report that active/uncertainty/random review queues and human-effort templates are ready.
claims.forbidden_now_ko: 사람 검수 시간이 절감되었거나 active review가 더 효율적이었다고 말하면 안 된다.
claims.forbidden_now_en: Do not claim reduced review time or active-review efficiency yet.
claims.safe_phrasing_ko: Active-review artifacts support review navigation only; efficiency claims require returned timing and correction evidence.
claims.safe_phrasing_en: Active-review artifacts support review navigation only; efficiency claims require returned timing and correction evidence.
unsafe_phrasing_examples: Active review reduces annotation cost.
The queue is proven more efficient than random review.

claims.allowed_now_ko: code, prompt, schema, synthetic public-safe examples, public-safe bundle 경계를 설명할 수 있다.
claims.allowed_now_en: We can describe code, prompts, schema, synthetic public-safe examples, and public-safe bundle boundaries.
claims.forbidden_now_ko: 원문 corpus 또는 내부 검수 파일을 공개할 수 있다고 말하면 안 된다.
claims.forbidden_now_en: Do not claim raw source corpus or internal review files can be released publicly.
required_before_stronger_claim: Rights review for any source-text release
Final public artifact audit after paper claims are fixed
claims.safe_phrasing_ko: Reproducibility is supported through public-safe artifacts; source-text release remains rights-gated.
claims.safe_phrasing_en: Reproducibility is supported through public-safe artifacts; source-text release remains rights-gated.
unsafe_phrasing_examples: All data will be publicly released.
The public bundle contains the full private corpus.

claim_policy: Use claimable_setup_or_diagnostic wording only for setup, construction, structural diagnostics, and reproducibility framing.
Use diagnostic_only or pending wording for any silver/proxy metric.
Do not state final extraction superiority until adjudicated human-gold scoring is complete.
Do not state NCS/PCF mapping utility until expert review returns are imported.
Do not state active-review efficiency until timing/correction evidence is returned.
Do not state public release of source text until rights review is complete.
